meta.title: Blinds and Shades in Boulder City, NV | BC Glass & Tint
meta.description: Roller, cellular and Roman shades, motorized if you want it, measured at your home in Boulder City, Henderson or Las Vegas. Free in-home measure and quote.

v3.eyebrow: Blinds and shades. Measured at your home.
v3.lede: Light, privacy and the feel of the room. Every blind and shade is measured at your windows and built to fit, motorized if you want it.

prices.lede: The style and the size of each window set the price, so we measure first. The measure and the quote are free.

blocks.heading: Find the right shade.
blocks.lede: Every room handles light differently. We help you pick the shade that fits the room, then build it to fit your windows.

items.title: Roller shades
items.text: A smooth fabric panel that rolls away for the full view and drops for privacy. A tighter weave blocks more glare; a more open weave keeps your view.

items.title: Cellular shades
items.text: Honeycomb cells hold a layer of air at the glass, which helps insulate a room against summer heat and winter cold.

items.title: Roman shades
items.text: Soft fabric that gathers into folds as it lifts, for a warm, finished look in bedrooms and living rooms.

items.title: Motorized
items.text: Available on any of the above. No cords, and tall or hard to reach windows go on a remote or a schedule.

items.title: Measured at your windows.
items.text: Every blind and shade is ordered to the measurements taken at your home, never pulled off a shelf.

items.title: Installed and checked.
items.text: We install every unit and check how it works before we leave. If anything is not right, tell us and we fix it.

items.title: Home window film
items.text: Keeps your view and helps cut glare and heat on sun-facing glass.

items.question: What kinds of blinds do you install?
items.answer: Roller, cellular and Roman shades, plus motorized options on any of them. Everything is measured at your windows and ordered to those measurements.

items.question: Are custom blinds done the same day?
items.answer: No, and it is worth knowing up front. Blinds and shades are measured at your windows and then ordered to those measurements, so there is a wait between the measure and the install. We will tell you the expected timing when we measure.

items.question: I already have blinds that need fixing. Can you help?
items.answer: New blinds and shades are what we install. If something you already own needs work and you are not sure where to start, call us anyway and we will help you work out the right next step.

items.question: Do you come to my house?
items.answer: Yes. We measure and install at your home or office.
